'''Pad 560''' was a landing pad in a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on a [[Unidentified green-skied planet|green-skied planet]]. Shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Dewell Bronk]] landed on the planet on a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that had traveled from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Bronk had to transfer to Pad 560 to continue on his journey into the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], but while trying to reach the pad ran into two [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who attempted to arrest him. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] then saved Bronk, allowing him to reach Pad 560 and board his transport.<ref name="Inc" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pad 560 first appeared in "[[Incognito]]," a short story by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[John Jackson Miller]] and illustrated by [[Chris Scalf]], which was published in ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' [[Star Wars Insider 143|143]] in [[2013]]. The story served as a tie-in to Jackson's novel [[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']], which was released later that year.
